en-US.description: Central management of LANCOM Wireless ePaper infrastructures
en-US.longDescription: The contents of the LANCOM Wireless ePaper Displays can be centrally and easily managed via the LANCOM Wireless ePaper Server. It manages and monitors the access points as well as all licensed LANCOM Wireless ePaper Displays.
en-US.name: LANCOM Wireless ePaper Server
